blockers.title: Import silently changes accepted text containing NUL or unpaired Unicode surrogates
blockers.evidence: src/persistence/courseArchiveFormat.ts:210 and :220 accept arbitrary nonempty string IDs and arbitrary TEXT strings. src/persistence/courseArchive.ts:113 commits these values through parameter binding. The pinned node_modules/@journeyapps/wa-sqlite/src/sqlite-api.js:239–247 binds text with length -1. Independent tests using production importCourseArchive and the installed WA-SQLite WASM/API demonstrate successful imports whose stored values differ from the validated archive.
blockers.reproduction: Run npx vitest run --config test-results/d4-data-review/vitest.config.ts -t unrepresentable. Both identity assertions fail at test-results/d4-data-review/review.test.ts:552. A valid synthetic archive with courseNote 'before\u0000after' passes createCourseArchive and importCourseArchive resolves, but querying the committed row returns 'before'. With 'before\ud800after', the committed value becomes 'before\ufffdafter'. The scratch adapter uses the real pinned WA-SQLite driver with an in-memory schema and production import logic. The independent wa-text.mjs probe separately confirms the driver's conversion. Scratch files were also preserved in the OS temporary cvc-d4-data-review directory.
